scope: All 1,044 published or already-due scheduled Briefs in the captured inventory. Editorial triage reviewed title and context; selected rewrites checked against stored primary-source passages. Retention is not a fresh independent fact-check of every claim.
criteria: Explain effects, scope, limits, background, or original data methodology beyond copied source provisions.
Do not treat proposals as enacted measures, applications as approvals, or agency assertions as independently verified outcomes.
Archive thin or stale public copy recoverably; keep underlying source documents and prior revisions.
No minimum article count or word count is used as an AdSense approval threshold.
rollback: Archived items remain in brief and can be restored through admin. brief_revision preserves the full pre-change row at version_before. Restore only after substantive review; never bulk republish without checking subsequent edits.
sources: Ten rewritten Briefs use the primary-source evidence stored with their generation jobs and linked official documents. Full inventory snapshot retained separately; this repository contains no private editor notes or user identifiers.

additional_repairs.change: Corrected four point citation IDs to match the existing source_1. Counts remain 125 retained and 10 rewritten.
